description: Create a document, select text, change font, size and colour

questions.explain: Like Notepad — remember where you save.

questions.prompt: Word is a pretty notebook with coloured pens and pictures.

learn.intro: Notepad is a simple squared notebook. Word is a pretty notebook with coloured pens! Today we make text beautiful.

slides.text: In **Word** you can make text pretty: colours, sizes, pictures. Open Word → "New document".
At the top there's a ribbon with buttons. There are many, but we need only a few.

check.prompt: How is Word different from Notepad?
options: You can make text pretty in it
check.explain: Word is a notebook with coloured pens.

slides.text: To change text we first **select** it — show the computer which piece we change. Click before the word, hold the button and drag to the end.
The text turned blue — it is selected. **Ctrl + A** selects everything.
**Font** is handwriting. **Size** — the bigger the number, the bigger the letters. **Colour** — the letter A with a coloured bar, like a coloured pen.
The main rule: **select first, then change**. If you didn't select — nothing changes.
